tbesh_html:
: waste_away
1) to flow, gush, issue, discharge
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to flow, gush
1a2) to die, pine away (fig.)
1a3) to flow (of issue from woman), have an issue, flux
1a4) flowing (participle)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to flow freely (as water), i.e. (specifically) to have a (sexual) flux; figuratively, to waste away; also to overflow
strongs_1890.kjv_def: flow, gush out, have a (running) issue, pine away, run.
